item.title: 🔴 Dysphoria IoT Botnet Adds Blockchain C2 and Victim Relays After JackSkid Disruption
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
Dysphoria, an Internet of Things (IoT) botnet line tracked by CNCERT and XLab, has adopted blockchain-based name services and infected-device relays after a March law-enforcement operation against JackSkid infrastructure.
